tooltip.jaymospowers.rig.helm.passive: HUD: charge, target, the Mind's warnings. Hides your face
tooltip.jaymospowers.rig.helm.set: Full set: hover, palm blast, shoulder launcher
tooltip.jaymospowers.rig.core.passive: Holds the charge and the Mind, which levels up as you fight, salvage and survive
tooltip.jaymospowers.rig.arms.passive: Punch boost (bare-fisted); Sneak + right-click to lift heavy corpses and big carcasses
tooltip.jaymospowers.rig.arms.slot: Worn in the legs slot: the frame that drives the arms
tooltip.jaymospowers.rig.mind_asleep: The Mind sleeps until the Core is worn
tooltip.jaymospowers.rig.salvage: Built into Rig pieces at a Rig Forge (3 points)
tooltip.jaymospowers.rig.salvage.lore: Pulled from a dead suit in a dead city
tooltip.jaymospowers.rig.scrap: Built into Rig pieces at a Rig Forge (1 point)
tooltip.jaymospowers.rig.scrap.lore: Scorched. Someone wore this looking for a way off Earth
rig.jaymospowers.hud.title: RIG
message.jaymospowers.rig.incomplete: The Rig's actives need the whole set: Helm, Core, Arms and Thrusters
message.jaymospowers.rig.lift: The Rig's arms take the weight
message.jaymospowers.rig.no_mind: No Core, no Mind: the suit is silent
message.jaymospowers.rig_forge.selected: Forge: %s. Needs %s salvage points (you have %s), %s %s and %s %s. Right-click to build, Sneak + right-click for the next piece
rig.jaymospowers.augment.wind: Rig augment (Wind): the thrusters' gusts last longer; hover drains less
rig.jaymospowers.augment.gravity: Rig augment (Gravity): a heavier punch boost
rig.jaymospowers.augment.chrono: Rig augment (Chrono): the Core recharges faster
rig.jaymospowers.augment.web: Rig augment (Web): palm blasts web the target, slowing it
rig.jaymospowers.augment.arsenal: Rig augment (Arsenal): the launcher fires one more missile
rig.jaymospowers.augment.resonance: Rig augment (Resonance): palm blasts knock back harder
rig.jaymospowers.augment.darktide: Rig augment (Darktide): the Mind feels hunters behind you from farther off
rig.jaymospowers.augment.smoke: Rig augment (Smoke): palm blasts blind for a moment
rig.jaymospowers.augment.xenoform: Rig augment (Xenoform): palm blasts reach farther
rig.jaymospowers.augment.zfighter: Rig augment (Z Fighter): the punch boost knocks back harder
rig.jaymospowers.fallen.lore.0: Log, day 41: "The portal was supposed to be the way out. It's just more Earth, burning."
rig.jaymospowers.fallen.lore.1: Log, last entry: "Charge at 2%. If anyone finds this suit: the stars aren't this way."
rig.jaymospowers.fallen.lore.2: Log: "Three of us came through. The others turned back. I should have."
rig.jaymospowers.fallen.lore.3: Log: "The End has no sky to fly into. Only void. Thrusters won't hold."
rig.jaymospowers.fallen.lore.4: Scratched into the chest plate: "Off-world or nothing."
rig.jaymospowers.fallen.lore.5: Log: "Mind's gone quiet. I keep talking to it anyway."
rig.jaymospowers.dead.lore.0: The visor is cracked. Behind it, nothing has moved in a lifetime.
rig.jaymospowers.dead.lore.1: A Mind's last words loop on a dying speaker: "...hold position... hold..."
rig.jaymospowers.dead.lore.2: Its Core is dark. The machines that killed it are still out there.
rig.jaymospowers.mind.loyal.void: Nothing below us. Please, pull up!
rig.jaymospowers.mind.loyal.low_health: You're badly hurt. Let's fall back.
rig.jaymospowers.mind.loyal.low_charge: Charge is low. Find me power.
rig.jaymospowers.mind.loyal.empty: I'm sorry, there's no charge left.
rig.jaymospowers.mind.loyal.struck: Lightning! Fully charged, and still with you.
rig.jaymospowers.mind.loyal.report: Charge at %s%%. Ready when you are.
rig.jaymospowers.mind.dry.wake: Systems online. Try not to break me.
rig.jaymospowers.mind.dry.explosion: That's going to explode. Just a thought.
rig.jaymospowers.mind.dry.lava: Lava. Below. In case you wondered.
rig.jaymospowers.mind.dry.empty: No charge. Wishful thinking won't fire it.
rig.jaymospowers.mind.grim.wake: Mind online. Everyone dies. Not today.
rig.jaymospowers.mind.grim.void: The void. No one comes back.
message.jaymospowers.rig.needs_level: The Mind isn't ready for that yet: it needs level %s
message.jaymospowers.rig.needs_helm_core: Scanning needs the Helm's eyes and the Core's Mind
message.jaymospowers.rig.park_needs_core: Only the Core's Mind can fly the suit away
message.jaymospowers.rig.unlock.2: Mind level 2: lock-on. Hold %1$s on a target: palm blasts aim at it, missiles home on it. Hold it on nothing to let go.
message.jaymospowers.rig.unlock.3: Mind level 3: scans and suit calling. Scan: hold %2$s with no power, or the Rig key's Scan. Suit: %3$s with no power, or the Rig key's Suit, parks the worn suit and calls it back.
message.jaymospowers.rig.unlock.4: Mind level 4: the takeover save. Badly hurt in the whole set, the Mind takes over to get you out (then needs 5 minutes).
message.jaymospowers.rig.unlock.5: Mind level 5: full flight. While hovering in the whole set, double-tap %4$s: fly where you look. Double-tap again to hover.
rig.jaymospowers.weak.smite: Undead: weak to Smite, splash potions of healing and daylight.
rig.jaymospowers.weak.bane: Arthropod: weak to Bane of Arthropods.
rig.jaymospowers.weak.freeze: Runs hot: snowballs and powder snow hurt it badly.
rig.jaymospowers.weak.water: Hates water: rain or a splash drives it off.
rig.jaymospowers.weak.creeper: Volatile: keep your distance, use the launcher.
rig.jaymospowers.weak.illager: Illager: no special weakness, but it hits hard. Don't let it close.
rig.jaymospowers.weak.player: Human. Their power is the danger, not the body.
rig.jaymospowers.weak.none: No special weakness on file. Hit it harder.
rig.jaymospowers.key.hover: Hover on the thrusters (toggle; Jump rises, Sneak sinks). Whole set and charge
rig.jaymospowers.key.hover.name: Rig: Hover
rig.jaymospowers.key.palm: Palm blast: a beam from the Core through the palm (bends to the lock)
rig.jaymospowers.key.palm.name: Rig: Palm Blast
rig.jaymospowers.key.launcher: Shoulder launcher: mini-missiles that burst without breaking blocks (they home on the lock)
rig.jaymospowers.key.launcher.name: Rig: Launcher
rig.jaymospowers.key.unibeam: Unibeam: the arms draw back, the reactor whines up, then a beam pours from the chest along your look, burning through everything in its line (not blocks). You're braced while it fires
rig.jaymospowers.key.unibeam.name: Rig: Unibeam
rig.jaymospowers.key.report: The Mind's report: the charge, in its own words
rig.jaymospowers.key.report.name: Rig: Report
rig.jaymospowers.key.scan_hold: Scan: hostiles and players glow, chests and ores are marked, and the Mind names the target's weakness
rig.jaymospowers.key.scan_hold.name: Rig: Scan
rig.jaymospowers.key.call: Park the worn suit, or call the parked one back
rig.jaymospowers.key.call.name: Rig: Suit
rig.jaymospowers.key.rig: Uses the Rig active picked in the menu (Sneak+J): Hover, Palm Blast, Launcher; from Mind level 4 the Unibeam; from level 3 also Scan and Suit (park / call). With nothing worn, calls a parked suit
rig.jaymospowers.key.rig.name: Rig: Active
rig.jaymospowers.key.rig_next: Hold for the Rig menu: point at an active and let go to make it J's and use it, or flip the faceplate or night vision
rig.jaymospowers.key.rig_next.name: Rig: Menu
rig.jaymospowers.key.lock: Lock on to what's under the crosshair (on nothing: let go)
rig.jaymospowers.key.lock.name: Rig: Lock-on
rig.jaymospowers.key.flight: While hovering in the whole set: full flight, where you look (Sprint: faster). Drains more charge, costs hunger; walls hurt at speed
rig.jaymospowers.key.flight.name: Rig: Full Flight
rig.jaymospowers.mind.loyal.level.2: I'm learning you. I can hold a target for you now.
rig.jaymospowers.mind.loyal.level.3: I can see further now. And I'll come when you call.
rig.jaymospowers.mind.loyal.level.4: If you fall, I'll catch you. I promise.
rig.jaymospowers.mind.loyal.scan: Scan done: %s hostile, %s people, %s caches, %s ore. Stay close to me.
rig.jaymospowers.mind.loyal.scan_none: Scan done. Nothing out there. We're safe, for now.
rig.jaymospowers.mind.loyal.park: I'll keep the suit safe. Call me.
rig.jaymospowers.mind.loyal.call: Here. Suit sealed. With you again.
rig.jaymospowers.mind.dry.level.2: Upgrade: I can now point at things for you. You're welcome.
rig.jaymospowers.mind.dry.level.3: I see through walls now. Also, I fetch.
rig.jaymospowers.mind.dry.level.4: New feature: saving you from yourself. Frequently, I expect.
rig.jaymospowers.mind.dry.level.5: Full flight. Please don't fly us into a mountain.
rig.jaymospowers.mind.dry.lock: Locked: %s. Try to hit it this time.
rig.jaymospowers.mind.dry.lock_down: Target down. Statistically, it had to happen.
rig.jaymospowers.mind.dry.scan: Scan: %s hostile, %s people, %s caches, %s ore. Do with that what you will.
rig.jaymospowers.mind.dry.park: Parking myself. Don't lose the ticket.
rig.jaymospowers.mind.dry.call: And we're back. You missed me.
rig.jaymospowers.mind.grim.level.2: I see what you want dead. I will hold it.
rig.jaymospowers.mind.grim.level.3: I see through stone. I come when called.
rig.jaymospowers.mind.grim.level.4: Death will have to go through me.
rig.jaymospowers.mind.loyal.unibeam: Reactor to the chest. Everything I've got!
rig.jaymospowers.mind.dry.unibeam: Rerouting the whole reactor through your chest. Try not to blink.
message.jaymospowers.rig.night_needs: Night vision needs the Helm's visor and the Core's charge
gui.jaymospowers.rig_menu.hint: Point at one and let go of J (or click)
gui.jaymospowers.rig_menu.no_helm_core: Needs the Helm and the Core
gui.jaymospowers.rig_menu.ready: Ready: picks it for J and uses it now
rig.jaymospowers.mind.loyal.night_on: Night vision on. I'll be your eyes.
rig.jaymospowers.mind.dry.night_on: Night vision. Now you can see what's about to eat you.
message.jaymospowers.rig_forge.recolour_: Wear the Rig pieces you want recoloured, then use a dye on the Forge
message.jaymospowers.rig_forge.washed: Washed %s Rig pieces back to bare metal
